# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]
[Four medical Professionals walking down a hallway]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

[ Learn More About Y-Knotless™ Flex ][171]

# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]
[Four medical Professionals walking down a hallway]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

[ Learn More About Y-Knotless™ Flex ][171]

TOP INDICATIONS AND PROCEDURES
[ [GMC1877-shutterstock_1799586823-IN-SHAPE.png] Burn wound management Burn wounds are a global
public health problem and a leading cause of morbidity, including prolonged hospitalisation,
disfigurement and disability – often accompanied by stigma and social rejection.¹ Our aim is to help
mitigate the complications associated with burn wounds. ][11] [
[HERO-ALLEVYN-LIFE-PIP-EXPLOSION-1000X1000PX-NO-BG.png] Pressure injury prevention Trusted to reduce
the incidence of pressure injuries when used as part of a comprehensive prevention program, compared
to standard care alone.^{1-3} ][12] [ [PartialThicknessTear_HeroCutout(24901)_20250211]
Partial-thickness rotator cuff tears Partial-thickness tears can have a lasting impact on pain and
shoulder function. When used in isolated bioinductive repair, the REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant
leads to tendon healing without the need for sutured repair;^{1-4} offering patients a faster
recovery and return to activity than sutured repairs.^{4,5} ][13] [ [CARTIHEAL Procedure page Hero
Image.png] Chondral and osteochondral knee repair Treat knee cartilage lesions and osteochondral
defects in a single-stage procedure, even in the presence of mild to moderate osteoarthritis
(Kellgren-Lawrence 0-3),^{1,2} with the porous, biocompatible CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage
Repair Implant; shown to be clinically superior to the current surgical standard of care in level 1
clinical data.^{*1,2} ][14]

# Fueled by Connections
# 
# to Transform Rare Diseases^{™}

We are
*Agios*

We are committed to continually raising the bar for ourselves and our science. But we don’t do it
alone.

The relationships we cultivate across and outside of our organization deepen our impact as leaders
in the field of cellular metabolism and propel our ability to bring new therapies to market.

[ View our corporate video ][37]

Our ability to work together with patient communities, healthcare professionals, partners and
colleagues – and honor each of their perspectives – powers our continued success in creating
groundbreaking therapies for the patients who need them.

The intersection of our experiences and expertise catalyzes ideas and unearths insights. It sparks
creativity. It creates efficiency. It drives scientific discoveries that result in pioneering
therapies.

What *patients *are
saying about us

*Golie,*

living with sickle cell disease

> Working with Agios has been a breath of fresh air! It is clear that the Agios team’s primary
> objective is to provide treatments that will address the needs of the patients they represent.

*Patients*
at the center

We’re here to make a difference in the lives of people with rare diseases.

At Agios, we put patient needs, concerns, input and collaboration at the center of our work. That’s
how we help to ensure that the therapies we’re developing and the complementary support programs
we’re providing address their needs and deliver the biggest impact possible.

[ Learn More ][38]

*Laurice,*

living with thalassemia

> *Patient engagement* isn’t just a box-ticking exercise at Agios. They form sincere connections
> with patients and advocates, to be sure our perspective and experience are front and center from
> the start.

Our pioneering leadership in cellular metabolism

Since our founding, Agios has been a pioneering leader in cellular metabolism, advancing therapies
for patients with unmet needs. Our mature and unique understanding of the science is foundational to
our success and the connective thread that binds our people and our pipeline together.

[ Our Science ][39]

Our therapeutic areas of focus

We are developing therapies for people with rare diseases, with a near-term focus on hemolytic and
acquired anemias. Our goal is to establish a strong portfolio of therapeutic candidates that have
the potential to provide disease-modifying and long-term rather than merely palliative effects for
patients with unmet needs.

[ Our Areas of Focus ][40]

What’s new

at *Agios*

Inside *Agios*

At Agios, our culture is central to our success. And central to our culture is our commitment to
maintaining a supportive and flexible work environment — where every person is encouraged to bring
their whole selves to the office (physically or virtually).

We believe that when people feel seen and respected, they’re able to do their best work. Each of us
bringing our best enables Agios to push the boundaries of science and make the biggest impact
possible in the lives of people with rare diseases.

[ Our Culture ][41]

*Join our team*

Do you want to be part of a team that knows how to turn great science into medicines that *change
lives*? Explore our open positions!

The intersection of our experiences and expertise catalyzes ideas and unearths insights. It sparks
creativity. It creates efficiency. It drives scientific discoveries that result in pioneering
therapies.

What *patients *are
saying about us

*Golie,*

living with sickle cell disease

> Working with Agios has been a breath of fresh air! It is clear that the Agios team’s primary
> objective is to provide treatments that will address the needs of the patients they represent.

*Patients*
at the center

We’re here to make a difference in the lives of people with rare diseases.

At Agios, we put patient needs, concerns, input and collaboration at the center of our work. That’s
how we help to ensure that the therapies we’re developing and the complementary support programs
we’re providing address their needs and deliver the biggest impact possible.

[ Learn More ][38]

*Laurice,*

living with thalassemia

> *Patient engagement* isn’t just a box-ticking exercise at Agios. They form sincere connections
> with patients and advocates, to be sure our perspective and experience are front and center from
> the start.

Our pioneering leadership in cellular metabolism

Since our founding, Agios has been a pioneering leader in cellular metabolism, advancing therapies
for patients with unmet needs. Our mature and unique understanding of the science is foundational to
our success and the connective thread that binds our people and our pipeline together.

[ Our Science ][39]

Our therapeutic areas of focus

We are developing therapies for people with rare diseases, with a near-term focus on hemolytic and
acquired anemias. Our goal is to establish a strong portfolio of therapeutic candidates that have
the potential to provide disease-modifying and long-term rather than merely palliative effects for
patients with unmet needs.

[ Our Areas of Focus ][40]

What’s new

at *Agios*

Inside *Agios*

At Agios, our culture is central to our success. And central to our culture is our commitment to
maintaining a supportive and flexible work environment — where every person is encouraged to bring
their whole selves to the office (physically or virtually).

We believe that when people feel seen and respected, they’re able to do their best work. Each of us
bringing our best enables Agios to push the boundaries of science and make the biggest impact
possible in the lives of people with rare diseases.

[ Our Culture ][41]

*Join our team*

Do you want to be part of a team that knows how to turn great science into medicines that *change
lives*? Explore our open positions!

# BiopharmaVantage

BiopharmaVantage is a specialty healthcare and life sciences consulting firm that partners with
clients to help them take optimal decisions. We assist pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics
and medical devices companies as well as healthcare and life sciences private equity and venture
capital investors and other consultancies in driving the value of their initiatives. We bring
unrivaled expertise of the healthcare and life sciences sector and take pride in providing
exceptional quality solutions in a cost-effective manner.

## Create a **new world** in **neurosurgery** with us

At Black Forest Medical, we envision a future where cranial stabilization is safer, more reliable,
and more innovative than ever. We ensure that a patient’s head can be positioned safely and
effectively during neurosurgical procedures, empowering healthcare professionals to achieve optimal
patient outcomes.


 

[Visit Us (360° Tour)][28]

 

 

# **Advancing **
# **Patient Safety**

Our commitment to patient safety and our dedication to empowering neurosurgeons with reliable
solutions drive our continued research in cranial stabilization. Discover our evidence-based
workflow recommendations intended to enhance procedural safety. Stay connected to follow our ongoing
research and emerging insights.
 

[Explore here][29]

# **DORO LUCENT**

The DORO LUCENT® Skull Clamp is the ideal choice for all neurosurgical procedures involving
intraoperative CT, X-Ray based Angiography or X-Ray imaging. It is designed to support superior
imaging results and precise control. Its unique and patented release mechanism, along with all
controls, can be accessed without the need to change hand positions, enabling neurosurgeons to fully
operate the clamp themselves. Additionally, interchangeable pin holders support the correct pin
configuration for every patient and head size.

[Learn more][30]

###  

### WHY IS DORO® THE PERFECT HELPER FOR NEUROSURGERY?

 

[About DORO®][31]

##### **Always Suitable - Multiple Application Options**
* From newborns to seniors, from non-invasive to invasive applications, from a wide range of
  standard OR tables to carbon-fiber tabletops to spinal frames, from standard to imaging
  environments – there is always a matching DORO® solution.
* DORO® systems exist for each patient positioning need.
* DORO® systems can be mixed and matched with each other thanks to their common interfaces.
* DORO® systems give users the possibility to adjust the system to each user and patient
  individually.
* DORO® systems are designed with a great simplicity and similarity to each other, allowing an
  intuitive handling of all systems.

 

##### **More than 30 Years of Expertise - Proven Solutions**

We specialize in optimal cranial stabilization and brain retraction for more than two decades and
are constantly driven to develop solutions that fit the latest technologies used in surgical
theaters worldwide. From horseshoe to 3-pin rigid cranial fixation – DORO® systems provide proven
methods guaranteeing a high level of stability during neurosurgical interventions as well as greater
safety for patients.

## Blood Bag Tube Sealers With a Wide Range of Functions

In our range of Qseal blood bag tube sealers we offer you for example:
* [**Qseal-free**][35] – a battery-operated cordless blood bag tube sealer for both EVA and PVC
  tubing. The construction is light-weighted and ergonomic, which makes it ideal for usage in mobile
  donation sites.
* [**Qseal-multi**][36] – a benchtop blood bag tube sealer ideal for both single – and multi-use.
  You can connect up to 8 units in multi-setup and operate as segment sealers, with simultaneous
  sealing.
* [**Qseal-opti**][37] – a shockproof and robust benchtop blood bag tube sealer – ideal for heavy
  duty use. Produces both single- and multi-seals.

## A Little About CSD Credit Union

In 1959, CSD Credit Union was formed to provide the employees of CSD-1 (Hickman Mills School
District) with an alternative to traditional for profit banking institutions. The first

# [][43]
# Elle Brough

Hi, I'm Elle Brough, a Mechanical/Biomedical Engineer interested in medical device research and
development. I hold a B.S. in Mechanical Engineering with an additional major in Biomedical
Engineering from Carnegie Mellon University (CMU).

I have experience working with implantable glaucoma devices and nitinol, developing testing set-ups
for stroke and spinal cord research, teaching and grading core mechanical engineering courses, and
training students on manufacturing processes.

See my course/research projects on the [CMU Projects][44] page, take a look at more informal
projects I've completed on the [For Fun][45] page, or see my work history on the [CV][46] page.

Adjustable Device to Prevent Secondary CNS Injury With HeadStrait Labs

## Patients decide in the kitchen, not the clinic.

Working in hundreds of clinics nationwide, we discovered something simple: patients are nudged
forward into the right treatment by **the voice of their own doctor**, delivered as a short video,
in a text message they can watch at the kitchen table, alongside their spouse.

SMS + RCS Technology

### Meet patients where they already are.

**87% of consumers ignore phone calls from unknown numbers.** But text messages? A 98% open rate
within 3 minutes.

Hoot uses SMS and RCS (Rich Communication Services) to deliver branded, interactive,
compliance‑reviewed content straight to a patient’s native messaging app. No downloads. No logins.
No friction.

**RCS brings app‑like experiences to texting:** verified sender badges, rich media carousels,
interactive buttons and video playback, all inside the patient’s default inbox.

between a diagnostic room and adjacent operating rooms, bringing the MRI directly to the patient. 

[ Learn More ][56]

##### Comprehensive

# Services

#### [ Design ][57]

Customized operating suite designs integrate imaging modalities into surgical environments

#### [ Products ][58]

Products designed for use during intraoperative imaging, and supplied in cooperation with industry
leaders

#### [ Installation ][59]

Operating rooms are installed with the latest intraoperative imaging technologies

#### [ Support ][60]

Customers are supported with comprehensive clinical training and education

##### Empowering Neurosurgeons to

# Perform Minimally-Invasive Procedures

It is estimated that over 70,000 patients worldwide have benefited from image-guided therapy
solutions integrated into the InVision Operating Suite.

## Learn more about some common conditions that may occur

Scroll to learn more about the conditions

[Smiling lady leaning against building]

## Presbyopia

Presbyopia is a decreased ability to see nearby objects, especially in low light. Everyone will
become presbyopic, usually starting around the age of 40; however, laser vision correction offers a
treatment option for this condition.

[Cheerful bearded Black man smiling outside]

## Astigmatism

Astigmatism is a variation in the curvature of the cornea or in the shape of the eye's lens.
Astigmatism results in blurred or distorted vision at all distances. [Laser vision correction][14]
can address astigmatism.

[Older woman looking at the sea during sunrise]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is a condition in which a person does not have enough quality tears to lubricate and nourish
the eye. Dry Eye is a common problem, particularly in older adults. Treatment for dry eye symptoms
can help before [cataract][15] or [laser vision correction][16] procedures.

[Older gray haired black man sitting by a window in front of a bookshelf]

## Cataracts

[Cataracts][17] occur when the normally clear lens of the eye becomes cloudy. As aging occurs,
protein from the lens clumps together, causing blurring, clouding, and discoloration of the lens.
Cataracts are the #1 cause of preventable blindness.¹

## Presbyopia

Presbyopia is a decreased ability to see nearby objects, especially in low light. Everyone will
become presbyopic, usually starting around the age of 40; however, laser vision correction offers a
treatment option for this condition.

[Cheerful bearded Black man smiling outside]

## Astigmatism

Astigmatism is a variation in the curvature of the cornea or in the shape of the eye's lens.
Astigmatism results in blurred or distorted vision at all distances. [Laser vision correction][14]
can address astigmatism.

[Older woman looking at the sea during sunrise]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is a condition in which a person does not have enough quality tears to lubricate and nourish
the eye. Dry Eye is a common problem, particularly in older adults. Treatment for dry eye symptoms
can help before [cataract][15] or [laser vision correction][16] procedures.

[Older gray haired black man sitting by a window in front of a bookshelf]

## Cataracts

[Cataracts][17] occur when the normally clear lens of the eye becomes cloudy. As aging occurs,
protein from the lens clumps together, causing blurring, clouding, and discoloration of the lens.
Cataracts are the #1 cause of preventable blindness.¹

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

## What Are List Brokers and How Can They Help Your Business?

A list broker is a marketing professional who acts as an intermediary between businesses seeking
targeted prospects and the companies that own or manage marketing databases. Rather than spending
countless hours researching and comparing thousands of list options, businesses partner with list
brokers to quickly identify, procure, and deploy the most effective marketing lists for their
campaigns.

#### What List Brokers Do?
* Access 70,000+ lists from multiple sources
* Provide unbiased recommendations
* Negotiate competitive pricing
* Ensure data accuracy and compliance
* Guide campaign strategy

#### Why Use a List Broker?
* Save 20-40 hours of research time
* Avoid costly list mistakes
* Get expert targeting advice
* Access lists not publicly available
* Benefit from decades of testing data

#### When to Use a List Broker?
* Launching new market campaigns
* Expanding to new territories
* Testing different audience segments
* Need specialized/niche lists
* Want multi-channel coordination

## OUR MISSION

Razom, which means “together” in Ukrainian, is dedicated to upholding the principles of the
Revolution of Dignity (Maidan) and actively contributing to the establishment of a secure,
prosperous, and democratic Ukraine. We achieve this by creating, inspiring, and collaborating on
initiatives that motivate people to think, partner and do.

## DONATIONS

## $10

provides a family in the frontline areas with a hygiene kit.

## $55

provides 7-10 days for 1 child at a summer camp

## $150

is the cost of an Individual First Aid Kit (IFAK)

## $500

is the cost to run a psychological support camp for vulnerable children

## $1,000

can buy an individual field medic backpack or 1 Motorola DP4800 VHF Radio

## $1,500

provides 1 repair kit for houses damaged in liberated areas

[ DONATE NOW ][22]

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]
[ 15 more ][62]

## Robot Applications

Use robot arms for any manufacturing application. You can find plenty of examples in our
documentation.

Leading Emergency Response

We empower responders at every skill level with world-class trauma medicine products—when they need
them most
[Our Mission][65]

### OUR PRODUCTS

From high-performance medical bag essentials to hyper-realistic simulation equipment, our products
are trusted by medical professionals to preserve life.

Hemorrhage Control

Devices used to rapidly and effectively control traumatic bleeding in pre-hospital treatment.

Airway Management

Solutions for maintaining patient airways, organized to prioritize the least invasive maneuver for
each situation.

Respiration

Products that focus on correcting, managing, and monitoring injuries that affect a patient’s ability
to breath effectively.

Circulation & Bandages

Devices designed to rapidly gain access to the circulatory system to support resuscitation, manage
hemorrhage shock, and more.

Burn Management

Products that remove heat and instantly cool burns to minimize skin and tissue damage. A crucial
step in the Rampart™ System.

Head & Hypothermia

Warming technology to help maintain proper body temperature in trauma and non-trauma situations.

Moulage & Kits

Our range of moulage accessories is designed to simulate blood and open wounds.

# Barrow - St. Joseph's Scholarly Commons

## Browse Research and Scholarship [Follow][15]

[Publications by Department][16]

This Scholarly Commons features the research activity and scholarly works of Barrow Neurological
Institute at St. Joseph's Hospital and Medical Center. Barrow is an international leader in the
treatment, research, and education of brain and spinal diseases, conditions, and injuries. The
Institute's mission is to advance the knowledge and practice of medicine in neuroscience through
basic and clinical research, education of medical professionals, and innovation in clinical
techniques and technology.

and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

## A local perspective on global deals

### Expertise. Integrity. Results.

Corporate Finance International (CFI) is a trusted corporate finance lead advisor providing M&A
services to the worldwide middle market. Since our inception in 2006, we continue to partner with
entrepreneurs, private equity investors, and management teams who are planning to sell their
businesses, raise capital, restructure, or grow with acquisitions. We provide independent advice
that differentiates us through our focus on 16 market verticals, countless years of experience
dealing with complex transactions, and our international mentality encompassing over 300
professionals in 19 countries. We are proud to work alongside so many successful businesses with
dedicated leadership teams that know first-hand what entrepreneurship means. CFI continues to
prioritise executing deals with maximum discretion and minimal business disruption while delivering
value to all stakeholders.

Our corporate finance advisors are your strategic partner in the world of high-stakes financial
decisions. We act as a trusted confidant, guiding you through complex financial transactions like
mergers, acquisitions, or capital raising. Our skilled corporate finance advisors bring 25+ years of
experience to the table. They negotiate on your behalf, navigate regulatory hurdles, and connect you
with the right investors or partners. By leveraging their expertise and extensive network, our
corporate finance advisor can help you secure the most favourable terms and unlock significant value
for your company.

## YOUR CONNECTION TO INTEGRATED HEALTHCARE INFORMATION

The HCI Solution offers expert support in Healthcare System Integration, assisting with your IT
initiatives, custom solutions for unique challenges, and deeply integrated user-friendly products.
The HCI Solution provides healthcare IT system integration software solutions that connect people
with information to improve performance and enable better, more consistent patient care. Our secure,
reliable and cost-effective software solutions increase operational efficiency and reduce costs. The
mission of HCI is to be the partner that can be part of your team while providing guidance through
expertise and resources for operational assistance.

 

[Know More About HCI][26]

## SAVING TIME AND MONEY

With a focus on Meditech integrated solutions, complex technical services, The HCI Solution empowers
you and your staff to effectively manage growing workloads while optimizing time and resources.
Drawing from over 25 years of experience in the healthcare IT industry, The HCI Solution deeply
understands your challenges. Our tailored products and solutions are engineered to effortlessly and
securely provide the information you require, precisely when you need it. We encourage you to
explore our comprehensive range of healthcare IT integration products and services on our website.
Additionally, feel free to join our product webinars or reach out to us for a complimentary demo.

## YOUR CONNECTION TO INTEGRATED HEALTHCARE INFORMATION

The HCI Solution offers expert support in Healthcare System Integration, assisting with your IT
initiatives, custom solutions for unique challenges, and deeply integrated user-friendly products.
The HCI Solution provides healthcare IT system integration software solutions that connect people
with information to improve performance and enable better, more consistent patient care. Our secure,
reliable and cost-effective software solutions increase operational efficiency and reduce costs. The
mission of HCI is to be the partner that can be part of your team while providing guidance through
expertise and resources for operational assistance.

 

[Know More About HCI][26]

## SAVING TIME AND MONEY

With a focus on Meditech integrated solutions, complex technical services, The HCI Solution empowers
you and your staff to effectively manage growing workloads while optimizing time and resources.
Drawing from over 25 years of experience in the healthcare IT industry, The HCI Solution deeply
understands your challenges. Our tailored products and solutions are engineered to effortlessly and
securely provide the information you require, precisely when you need it. We encourage you to
explore our comprehensive range of healthcare IT integration products and services on our website.
Additionally, feel free to join our product webinars or reach out to us for a complimentary demo.

# Welcome to the TheSkeletalSystem.net

biology. Here at The Skeletal System, you can find details about all the 205 bones explained in an

functions of the bones.
